detail.noSummary: No summary yet — none of the sources carry a first-hand description.

detail.sourcesEmpty: No sources of this kind yet

detail.removeSignalFailed: Could not remove it, try again

follow.followed: Following — new developments will be flagged

empty.title: No events yet

empty.filteredDescription: Try another topic or clear the search

widget.emptyHint: Hit Follow on an event and new developments show up here

feed.heading: What's happening
feed.subheading: Events merged across sources — not a rearranged leaderboard

site.subscribeHint: Follow in any RSS reader — no account needed

entityIndex.title: Entities
entityIndex.subtitle: Every company, product and person this site is tracking

topic.title: {topic}
topic.subtitle: What's happening in {topic}, merged across sources

hero.headline: One story, many sources, one timeline

hero.entitySubhead: Every event involving {entity}, merged across sources — most recent first.

layout.label: Events radar
layout.description: Rising then Now — use this when the site root should be the events front door

feed.label: Event list
feed.sourceInfo: Rising = changing fastest; Now = still developing in the last 24 hours
feed.showSourcesInfo: Sources are the evidence for an event — keeping them is recommended

detail.label: Event detail
detail.showSourcesInfo: Turning this off leaves visitors unable to check the originals
detail.showRelatedInfo: Related events are not the same event, only connected ones
detail.showWhyInfo: States only checkable facts, and separates confirmed from discussion

subscribeLink.label: Subscribe link
subscribeLink.iconOnlyInfo: Shows just the RSS icon; the text above is kept as the accessible label and tooltip

hero.label: Hero
hero.showStatsInfo: Hidden automatically until there are events — never shows a row of zeros
hero.interpolationInfo: Use {topic} / {topic_slug} on topic pages, {entity} / {entity_kind} on entity pages, and {feed} for this page's RSS. Tokens for the other identity are empty.
hero.subscribeHrefInfo: Default {feed} — this page's RSS (topic, entity, or site). Pin a slot with /topics/ai/feed.xml.

entityHero.label: Entity hero
entityHero.showProfileInfo: How many times in the last 90 days, and for how long — the part the list below can't answer

token.topic: Name of the current topic, e.g. "AI"
token.topic_slug: URL segment of the current topic, for building links
token.headline: One-line summary of the current event (falls back to its title)
token.entity: Name of the current entity, e.g. "OpenAI"
token.entity_kind: Kind of the current entity, e.g. "Company"
token.feed: RSS feed address for the current page

edit.title: Edit event
edit.description: Change the title, summary, or topic. After you save, ingest will keep updating heat and the timeline, but it will not overwrite this copy.
edit.summaryInfo: This is the “what happened” text visitors see. Saving it locks the copy against the next analyzer run.
edit.updateFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

sources.title: Sources
sources.pageDescription: Sources are grouped by topic. Turning a topic off hides it on the site and pauses its feeds.
sources.createDescription: RSS for any site, or Hacker News via the built-in connector.
sources.editDescription: Rename it, change the address, or recategorize it.
sources.connectorInfo: RSS takes any feed URL. Hacker News uses the official API and does not need an address.
sources.topicGroupPaused: {{count}} sources paused — this topic is off
sources.topicGroupEmpty: No sources in this topic yet
sources.topicsNeedOne: Keep at least one topic enabled
sources.emptyDescription: Add an RSS feed or Hacker News to start collecting events for this site.
sources.deleteConfirmDescription: Stop collecting from “{{name}}”? Existing events stay; new items from this feed will not be added.
sources.createFailed: Could not add this source. Please try again.
sources.updateFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
sources.deleteFailed: Could not delete. Please try again.
